bound-exceeded and signal-unavailable require opposite remediations but produce identical metric signals, requiring shell access to journalctl to triage
split review_interrupts into two reason-specific metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) while retaining rolled-up total for history
observability.sh reuses existing publish_autodeploy_marker_delta helper with new offset files to emit separate metrics from journal patterns
